analysis.themes: An expedition into a zone where DNA refracts like light — the film reads cancer, grief, and self-destruction as facets of the same compulsion to change.
analysis.atmosphere: Beautiful wrongness; the Shimmer is gorgeous precisely where it should horrify, and that mismatch is the dread.
analysis.narrative: Five damaged women enter a place that unmakes things; the ending offers a mirror instead of an answer.
analysis.visual: Prismatic mutations — floral antlers, screaming bears, crystalline trees — make biology uncanny without a single cheap scare.
analysis.characters: Each member of the expedition is self-destructive in her own way; the Shimmer doesn't kill them, it obliges them.
